info.title: BugBuster API
info.description:
Ingest and Query API of the BugBuster backend.

Every route except `/openapi.json`, `/docs` and the admin routes needs your organization's API key as `Authorization: Bearer <apiKey>`. The key decides which organization's database a request reads or writes — there is no way to address another organization's data. Admin routes take the backend's `BUGBUSTER_ADMIN_TOKEN` instead.

You normally never call `POST /ingest` yourself: the SDK (`@bugbusterhq/sdk-node`) or the Agent does. The `GET` routes are what the dashboard uses, and are safe to script against.

post.summary: Send a batch of telemetry (used by the SDK and Agent)
post.description:
The body is NDJSON: one `EnvelopeItem` JSON object per line. Items of type `fold` and `exemplar` become issues, `log` items are stored as log lines (invalid ones are dropped individually), and `meta` items carry drop counters. Re-sending a batch is safe for logs (deduplicated by `logId`).

The response headers are backpressure directives the sender should obey.

parameters.name: Content-Encoding
parameters.description: `zstd` when the body is zstd-compressed (the Agent always compresses).

X-BB-Sample-Directive.description: Sample rates (0–1) the sender should apply per data type.

X-BB-Suppress-Fingerprints.description: JSON array of fingerprints to send counts for but no examples.

X-BB-Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before sending again. Only present when set.

403.description: The organization has been disabled by an operator. Nothing to retry; ask them to enable it.

413.description: The body is larger than the backend's limit (2 MB by default).

post.summary: Create an organization and its first API key
post.description:
Creates the organization (its data goes to its own database, `bugbuster_org_<orgId>`) and its first named key, and returns that key. **The key is shown only in this response**: only a hash is stored, so it can't be retrieved later.

Needs the backend's `BUGBUSTER_ADMIN_TOKEN` as the bearer token. When the backend has no admin token configured, the admin routes answer `404`.

orgId.description: Permanent id; also names the org's database.

logRetentionDays.description: Days to keep this organization's log lines; 0 keeps them forever. Omit for the backend's default.

keyName.description: Name of the first key. Default "Default key".

apiKey.description: Give this to the organization. It is not shown again.

logRetentionDays.description: Present only when the org was created with its own retention.

404.description: Admin routes are disabled (no admin token configured).

409.description: The orgId, or its database name, is already taken.

example.error: an org with this id or database already exists

patch.summary: Rename, change retention, or disable an organization
patch.description:
Send any of these:

- `name`: the display name.
- `logRetentionDays`: days to keep log lines (`0` keeps them forever), or `null` to use the backend's `BUGBUSTER_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS`. Applied to the organization's retention index immediately, for every backend process.
- `disabled`: `true` refuses every request with the organization's keys (`403 organization is disabled`) until it is set back to `false`. Data is kept. Takes effect within a minute on every backend instance.

logRetentionDays.description: Days to keep this organization's log lines; 0 keeps them forever. Omit for the backend's default.

400.description: Nothing to change, or a value is invalid.

example.error: logRetentionDays must be a whole number from 0 (keep forever) to 3650

404.description: No such organization, or admin routes are disabled.

post.summary: Create another API key for an organization
post.description: Give each service or person its own key, so one can be revoked without affecting the others. **The key is shown only in this response.**

delete.description: Requests with this key get `401 invalid api key` from now on, within a minute on every backend instance. The organization's other keys keep working. The key stays listed, marked revoked. Revoking twice is harmless.

404.description: No such key in this organization.

post.summary: Delete example events no issue uses
post.description: Backends before the exemplar fix stored example events past each issue's six; they take space and are never shown. This deletes them (events written in the last ten minutes are left alone). `dryRun: true` only counts.
